title: Galen Erso
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Galen Erso was a brilliant scientist who devoted his studies to learning about the relationship between energy amplification and kyber crystals. Naturally, his friend in the Empire, Director Orson Krennic, wanted that work devoted to the Death Star project and would stop at nothing to have it — including killing Erso's wife. Driven and dedicated, Erso planted a trap in the Death Star.
